statement_summary: Security lead and CMMC Affirming Official designated in writing
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Call-back and second approval for every bank detail change
Approved external systems list and vendor terms before FCI is shared
No Section 889 covered equipment; confirm actual manufacturer
Affirmations and representations only after evidence and counsel review
6-year retention of CMMC evidence and security records
Flow down FAR 52.204-21, 52.204-25, and CMMC level to subcontracts
Unique accounts; no shared trailer or laptop accounts
No single person can change bank details and release payment; dual approval
MFA everywhere; phishing-resistant MFA for payment roles and admins
Same-day termination; external users removed at closeout
Change default passwords before first use
Only managed devices reach FCI systems
Badges, locked trailers, visitor sign-in and escort, key inventory
Named approvers for public website content
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Bank recall and IC3 complaint for suspected payment diversion
Section 889 reports within 1 and 10 business days
Export logs at incident start; 90-day image preservation if CDI
Annual incident response test
CUI not accepted; quarantine and notify
FCI only inside the assessed boundary; no personal accounts
Sanitize media before disposal or reuse, with records
Isolated immutable backups tested quarterly
Annual training; payment-fraud training; phishing exercises
Never act on a bank change received by email
Approved generative AI tools only
